Also on Sunday per @planesenbarcelona: LasAlturas Market at Torre Bellesguard, Festival DAU board games at Fabra i Coats (free), CheesyFest. Check hours.

🕘 On now · until 03:00 · 📍 Seaseaclub Barcelona
📊 471 interested on RA · also on DICE, Xceed

🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 Bikini Club
📊 398 interested on RA
💬 Shall Ocin plays all night at Sala Bikini, a big-room melodic techno night that starts at midnight.
https://ra.co/events/2584551

4. SOUNDIT Club: Palms Trax All Night Long / POGO: Mietze Conte · ideasforconversa…
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 Nitsa Club
📊 51 interested on RA
💶 €22–25
💬 Nitsa at Sala Apolo with Palms Trax all night long; Apolo pushed it in its stories today and it is one of the city's main Saturday clubs.
https://ra.co/events/2566011

5. MEGA SATURDAY DJ PARTY & SALSA-BACHATA WORKSHOP + FREE CLUB ENTRY
🕘 On now · until 06:00 · 📍 D9 ARIBAU, Sant Gervasi - Galvany

💶 Free
💬 International social with a DJ party and free club entry at D9 Aribau, easy to join late and meet people.
https://www.eventbrite.es/e/entradas-mega-saturday-dj-party-salsa-bachata-workshop-free-club-entry-739189635097

TOMORROW · Sun 15 Nov

1. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Sun 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Sidecar
📊 232 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free weekly Sunday electronic night at Sidecar run by local DJs, the pick if you want a late one.
https://ra.co/events/2549258

2. ☀️New Montjuïc Social Hike & Vermut 🍷
🕘 Sun 11:00 → 14:00 · 📍 Hotel Barcelona Universal
📊 75 going on Meetup · group has 1,792 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 €7.51–14.48
💬 Social hike up Montjuïc ending with vermouth, a good daytime reset with an international crowd.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelonasocialhikers-com/events/317091780/

3. Baltic Session 🇱🇻 | Cider Tasting & Music @ TSH
🕘 Sun 18:00 → 22:00 · 📍 The Social Hub Barcelona, Provençals del Poblenou
📊 38 guests on Luma
💶 €20
💬 Latvian cider tasting with music at The Social Hub in Poblenou, a relaxed early-evening social with an international crowd.
https://luma.com/latvia-session

4. Salsa & Latin Vibes
🕘 Sun 18:00 → 22:00 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 #2 of 16 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 61 followers on Xceed
💶 €13.50–95
💬 Live salsa band and dancers at La Paloma on a Sunday evening, popular on Xceed.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/salsa-latin-vibes-73/249013

5. SUNDAY VIBES & HAPPY HOUR + STAND UP COMMEDY & LIVE MUSIC
🕘 Sun 19:00 → 00:00 · 📍 OGHAM
📊 48 going on Meetup (limit 250) · group has 49,856 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Sunday happy hour with stand-up comedy and live music at OGHAM, big international social group.
